title: Yeti hot cup
text: Yeti hot cup. I actually purchased 4 of these, 2 in the stainless and 2 in the army like green.  I intend to give them as gifts, so I haven't used them but I can say they are very nice.  Secure looking lids and smooth surfaces on the outside.  I purchased the 12 oz size so that they would fit easily in most any car cup holder - and these do fit in my 2021 Lexus RX 450h.  I purchased as I friend of mine has one and reports that it is the best hot cup she has ever owned.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: YETI Rambler 12 oz Bottle, Stainless Steel, Vacuum Insulated, with Hot Shot Cap
features: HOT SHOT CAP: 100% leakproof so carry it with confidence. Half twist until it clicks, then sip from any side. The 1 inch of FATLID Insulation keeps your drink piping hot
18/8 STAINLESS STEEL: Puncture- and rust-resistant thanks to its kitchen-grade stainless steel construction
NO SWEAT DESIGN: Prevents condensation, keeping hands dry
DISHWASHER SAFE: Because no one needs more work to do
DOUBLE-WALL VACUUM INSULATION: Keeps hot drinks hot (or cold drinks cold) until the last sip
